recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆巨噬細胞核周圍的淡色胞質內散布數十個均一的小型卵圓形紫色小體（Leishman-Donovan bodies），明顯比周圍顆粒小，符合利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體。
features: Macrophage with a single oval nucleus and pale, ill-defined cytoplasm filled with numerous small oval purple organisms
Organisms uniform, about 2-4 um, discrete and evenly scattered around the nucleus
Some organisms show a faint paired dot, but kinetoplast detail is limited at this magnification
Adjacent lymphocytes, band neutrophil, erythroblast and a monocyte-like cell in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage whose pale cytoplasm contains numerous small, uniform, oval basophilic organisms distributed around the nucleus. Surrounding cells include lymphocytes, maturing neutrophils and erythroid precursors, without other abnormal populations in this field. Internal kinetoplast detail is only faintly discernible at this magnification. Findings are consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies (Leishmania amastigotes), supporting visceral leishmaniasis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a clear halo, lack a kinetoplast and are GMS/PAS-positive.
Talaromyces yeasts are elongated with a central septum and lack a kinetoplast.
Platelets and debris are irregular and granular, without the uniform oval shape and nucleus-kinetoplast structure of amastigotes.
